messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: mapping URLs with shiny.
parts:
Sort of. Each Shiny application is a single page and thus a single URL--there's nothing to map. (If you have assets like CSS, JavaScript, and images, those can be served up as separate URLs, but they are generally just mapped to a directory.)

Shiny Server is used to host one or more Shiny applications on a server, with each application getting a different URL; in that case you use a config file to control the URL mapping.
